notes: Normalized from raw px to rem where the site's own custom properties were rem-based. The site is dark-ground-first with white content sheets laid on it — `color.bg` is the navy page body, `color.surface` the white sheet, and `fg`/`muted` are the light-sheet inks; the `*-on-dark` roles carry the inverse. `color.dark` is OMITTED: craft.theme.supportsDark reports true, but its sampled values are degenerate (bg `rgba(0,0,0,0)`, fg equal to the light-mode page ground) and the screenshots show no re-theme — the page has one theme that happens to be dark. Type scale collapses the site's 13 measured px sizes (12–72px) onto the nearest rem steps; 22px/28px one-offs dropped. Tracking is not a ramp: every size ≥18px computes to exactly -0.04em, body to 0. Shadow is listed as `none` because the loaded shadow scale is unused on this page — the only box-shadow that renders is the 2px focus ring. `reduced_motion: respected` follows the stylesheet, which carries one blanket `@media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) { *,::before,::after { animation: none; transform: none } }` reset; the raw probe's `respectsReducedMotion: false` / `prmRules: 0` is wrong (sheets partially sampled). The marquee's 60s is a loop duration, not a transition duration — kept in `durations` for provenance, never reuse it as a UI timing.
